services.purpose: Runs a private health dashboard with SQLite history and one self-check; other monitors require separate configuration.

configFiles.content:
storage:
  type: sqlite
  path: /data/gatus.db
endpoints:
  - name: gatus-self
    group: local
    url: http://127.0.0.1:8080/health
    interval: 1m
    conditions:
      - "[STATUS] == 200"

acceptance.description: GET /health on the exact private origin returns HTTP 200; this establishes only Gatus service readiness.
After separately reviewed target configuration, inspect status history for a selected real service and confirm expected check results.
Restart the exact owned project and verify configured targets and SQLite history remain available.
